name: What should I ask a remodeling contractor before signing a contract?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a remodeling contractor before signing a contract?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a remodeling contractor before signing a contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing, focus on the items that affect cost, quality, and accountability. Ask whether the contractor is licensed and insured, who will manage the project day to day, how permits and inspections are handled, and what happens if hidden conditions appear after demolition. You should also ask for a clear scope of work, allowances for materials, a payment schedule tied to milestones, and a written process for change orders. It helps to ask for examples of similar projects in Los Angeles, especially if your home has older construction, hillside conditions, or a custom luxury finish level. Communication matters too, so ask who your main contact will be and how often you will get updates. Warranty coverage should be clear in writing, including what is covered and for how long. A strong contractor should answer these questions directly and provide documentation without hesitation. If answers are vague, rushed, or overly promotional, that is a warning sign. The goal is not just to find the lowest price, but to avoid surprises once work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about licensing, insurance, permits, timeline, payment milestones, change orders, warranty, project management, and similar past work. You should also ask who will be on site daily and how unexpected issues will be handled.
